hooks.name: New codemod checklist
hooks.description: When RULES or the graveyard changes, make sure the rule is tested, documented in the migration-plan spec and surfaced in the UI.

action.prompt: The graveyard/knowledge base changed. For each new or changed package entry: (1) ensure engine/engine.test.ts covers it, (2) update .kiro/specs/migration-plan/requirements.md and tasks.md, (3) if it introduces a package make sure INTRODUCED has a reason. Summarise what you updated.
